name: COMP_037
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (73%)** · Ambiguous: InSitu vs Invasive · Careful review
InSitu stays in the 90% conformal set, though the input is not flagged and the second model agrees. [F1]

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Invasive 73%, InSitu 19% | Clear lead, not decisive |
| Conformal set | InSitu, Invasive | Cannot separate the two |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.955 / 94th percentile | Input not flagged |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Same top class | Agrees with main classifier |
| Similar cases | 2 of 5 Invasive | Mixed; 3 are InSitu |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (regions 3, 6, 7) · ↑ invasive · Strongest concept association with invasive carcinoma [F2] · Validated
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (regions 2, 7, 11) · ↑ invasive · Scored high but failed spot check, 0/20 [F3] · Unreliable
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (regions 2, 10, 11) · ↑ invasive · Elevated score; smaller contribution than stroma · Validated
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (regions 1, 9) · ↓ invasive · Associated with lower invasive likelihood; spot check 12/20 · Weak

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing the top 3 regions drops the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful to the classifier.
- **Concepts**: Deletion effect 0.002 (CI −0.005 to 0.007) includes 0, so unproven. Mitoses and normal lobules are Unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- InSitu is correct: 3 of 5 similar cases are InSitu, and the conformal set includes it.
- The mitosis score reflects artifact rather than true mitoses, since it failed its spot check.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 3, 6, 7:** confirm tumor cells infiltrate stroma rather than staying duct-bound.
2. **Regions 1, 9:** look for intact duct borders and myoepithelium suggesting InSitu.
3. **Regions 3, 7, 11:** confirm tumor at the lateral margin (simulated frozen section). [F7]
